arbiter: Hand-derived recurring half-open interval logic, no astronomical ephemeris
derivation: The Gregorian year 2000 is divisible by 400 and has 366 elapsed UTC days. Repeat the required set [0,12h), the preferred sets [0,6h) and [9h,18h), and the preferred unknown [6h,9h) every 24 elapsed hours. Partition each day at 0h,6h,9h,12h,18h,24h. Required failures cover [12h,24h); unknown preference never changes the required intersection. These are synthetic sets supplied to the coordinator, not Moon calculations.
